# Version 1.4.9
- Added Debug GUI Scale keybind, unbounded by default.
- Renamed "Simple Scroll Keybinds" category to "Simple Hold n' Scroll Keybinds".
- Renamed "Change *setting*" keybinds to just *setting*.
  - Ex: renamed "Change Master Volume" keybind -> "Master Volume".
- Scrolling keybinds only work when the player is not in a screen.


- Changed default Toggle Fog keybind to ALT + F *(f makes more sense for fog)*.
- Changed default Master Volume keybind to ALT + M *(since alt is closer to the M key)*.
- Changed default Brightness keybind to B.
- Changed default Toggle Chunk Borders keybind to ALT + B *(b makes more sense for chunk boundaries, using alt here because brightness now uses b key).*
- Changed default Render Distance keybind to R.
- Renamed Toggle Chunk Borders keybind to Toggle Chunk Boundaries.
- Unbounded Entity Distance keybind by default.
- Unbounded FOV keybind by default.


- Added missing translations.
- Fixed redundant key conflicts.

# Version 1.4.6

## Changes
- Update to 26.3.
- Now requires [Fabric Loader version 0.19.5](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) or greater.
- Now requires [DillonLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/dillon-lib) version 1.1 or higher.
- Now requires [YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) to configure specific settings.
- The mod logo now appears in the configuration screen.
- Revamped main menu screen.
- Renamed "Messages = Actionbar" to "Messages = Overlay".
- Renamed "Simple Scrolling Keybinds" category to "Simple Scroll Keybinds".
- Small backend optimizations.
  - Optimized translations.
- Closing the debug options screen when opening it from the Simple Keybinds main menu now properly sets the screen back to the main menu.

## Bugs Fixed
- Closing configuration screen does not save the messages option correctly.

releases.notes:
# Version 1.4 (MC Fabric 26.1.2, NeoForge 26.1.2):

# Changes
- `New mod icon!`
- New keybind to `reset brightness` (default = `ALT + V`).
- There are now `two separate simple keybind categories,` one for `basic keys (called Basic Simple Keybinds)` and one for `scrolling keys (called Simple Scrolling Keybinds).`
- You can `no longer toggle fullbright if auto brightness` is enabled.
- Keybinds can `now have modifiers.`
- Added a `brightness debug hud'.

## Dependency Updates
- Runs on `Minecraft 26.1.2`, not 26.1.1 or 26.1.
- *(Fabric only)* Now requires `Fabric Loader 0.19.2` or above to run.
- *(NeoForged only)* Now requires `NeoForged-beta` version `26.1.2.31` or greater to load.
- Now requires `Balm` version `25.1.2.5` or above to run.

## Other Changes
- Updated `lang.`
- The mod now suggests [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) and [Controlling](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlling) *(not required)*.

## Bugs Fixed
- Fixed `"unspecified"` jar build.
- Fixed possible crashes with conditiona mixins.

# Version 1.3.1 (MC Fabric 26.1, NeoForge 26.1, and 1.21.1 for Fabric/Forge/NeoForged):
# Balm Dependency
The mod now requires [Balm](https://modrinth.com/mod/balm) in order to run. This is to make developing on multiple mod loaders easier.

# Version 1.3 (MC Fabric 26.1, NeoForge 26.1):
## Config
- Added a configuration file for the mod.
- Added a configuration screen.
- Can be accessed with NeoForge, or via the Mod Menu mod with fabric.
- Fog is now toggleable in the configuration screen, in addition to the keybind.

## Auto-Brightness Option
- Automatically adjusts your brightness based on your current light level. This is OFF by default.

Version 1.2.8 (MC Fabric 1.21.11, Forge 1.20.1, 1.21.1-1.21.5, and 1.21.11):
- Added "Mute" keybind. You must hold "CTRL" to use it (default key = M).
- Reverted scrolling for change FOV keybind to make sense.
- Improved compatibility with the Speedrunner Mod.

Version 1.2.5:
- Ported to Forge!

- Added "Change FOV" keybind (default key = R, use scroll wheel in game to use)
- Added "Change GUI Scale" keybind (default key = G, use scroll wheel in game to use)

- Some scroll wheel keybinds will now reset to the lowest value when trying to go above the maximum value.
- Changed "Change Render Distance" default keybind to "U".

- Removed the "Toggle HUD" keybinding.
- Optimizations and tweaks.
- Added mod icon.

releases.notes:
--- Key Changes: ---
- New keybind to change master volume (using the scroll wheel): "M".
- The default key for Toggle Chunk borders is now "B".
- The default key for Change Render Distance is now "R".
- (1.21.9 exclusive) Removed the "Toggle Debug HUD" key, since you can already do this by simply pressing F3.

--- A few tweaks and improvements: ---
- Disabling fullbright now sets the brightness back to whatever it was before fullbright was toggled (unless the brightness previously was greater than or equal to 800%, as that is close enough to fullbright, the brightness will still be set to 100%. The game only remembers the previous value as long as it was toggled during the current game session).
- Changing options, like render distance and entity distance, will now display the message in a certain color which reflects performance (ex. 32 render distance will show in red, 8 render distance will show in green).
- Changing options now actually saves the value to the "options.txt" file.
- Removed error messages when attempting to increase/decrease a value above or below its max/min value.

All versions compatible with Fabric.
Versions 1.20.1, 1.21, and 1.21.1 compatible with Forge/NeoForge with the Sinytra Connector mod and Forgified Fabric API mod.
